parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE discovered_at::date = CURRENT_DATE) as discovered_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs) as total_jobs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE match_score >= 70) as matched_70,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE match_score >= 80) as matched_80,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE match_score >= 90) as matched_90,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications WHERE status = 'READY') as apps_ready,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications WHERE status = 'APPLIED') as apps_submitted,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications WHERE status = 'INTERVIEW') as interviews,
  (SELECT requests_made FROM ai_usage WHERE date = CURRENT_DATE) as ai_calls_today,
  (SELECT requests_limit FROM ai_usage WHERE date = CURRENT_DATE) as ai_limit;

SELECT j.company, j.title, j.location, j.remote, j.match_score, j.url
FROM jobs j
WHERE j.discovered_at::date = CURRENT_DATE
  AND j.match_score >= 70
ORDER BY j.match_score DESC
LIMIT 5;
